adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host` blindly assigning `host.category_id = params[:embeddable_host][:category_id]` (with fallback to uncategorized) and `TopicEmbed.import` using that host’s category (`category: eh.try(:category_id)`) while creating posts with `skip_validations: true`. There’s no guard in this diff preventing selection of a read-restricted/private category, nor any UI warning. However, this is primarily a configuration/UX footgun (admins can intentionally choose a private category), and the diff doesn’t prove a concrete security breach/leak or that permission checks are bypassed—only that the category can be set and then used for topic creation.
